notes: Owner specification-review ruling of 2026-09-02, given as BATCH 3 over the exact review object returned for this theorem at commit c5c173bb. This is the theorem's FIRST owner specification review; there is no earlier record and no inherited approval. ROOT STATUS. THM-0091 is accepted as a genuinely independent declared system root. Its subject is the sidecar's LOCAL ingress boundary before a signed MCP-RE exchange is initiated, so it is deliberately not a child of THM-0076 or of any response-acceptance theorem: the attack it excludes completes before a response exists. INGRESS AUTHORITY. The ruling accepts the decomposition LocalConfig -> BindScope -> AcceptedHttpAuthority -> local request admission -> only then a signed MCP-RE exchange. `BindScope` owns where the listener may be exposed; `AcceptedHttpAuthority` owns which HTTP authorities may reach the signing path. These are different facts and must remain different values: an operator declaration permitting a non-loopback bind must not disable the Host/DNS-rebinding guard. GUARDS AND ORDERING. The claimed pre-signing boundary is accepted as stated — framing settled first; duplicate `Content-Length` and duplicate `Host` refused rather than resolved; a present `Origin` refused; a `Host` outside `AcceptedHttpAuthority` refused; JSON content framing required; malformed JSON refused before the signed request pipeline is invoked. A request failing these cannot cause the sidecar to initiate a signed exchange. EXPLICIT NON-CLAIM, approved AND REQUIRED. This theorem does not identify or authenticate the local process that originated an otherwise admissible request. Loopback is NOT an authenticated channel. The local leg is not confidential. HTTP `Origin` is not authenticated; its PRESENCE is a refusal condition. THM-0091 may not later be used as a premise asserting local caller identity, process identity, channel confidentiality, or authenticated origin. DEPENDENCY DECISION. `depends_on = []` is accepted, and specifically the MEASURED exclusion of `client.trust_manifest_lifecycle`: ingress admission is determined from the validated local configuration and does not consume the trust document, and an edge added merely because both belong to the same shipped sidecar would be a false logical edge. The later trust and response-verification propositions remain separate. AVAILABILITY. The root is one-directional: requests outside the admitted ingress policy cannot reach signing. It does NOT promise that every admissible request is served, so the exchange deadline and bounded reader may appear in its supporting closure without making this an availability theorem. The approval was made conditional on immediate remeasurement; the fingerprint was recomputed at c5c173bb before this record was written and equals the value the owner named. `theorem_dependencies` is empty because the theorem is a root, so this approval is over its own claim text alone.
